name: SageReasoning Stoic Brain
description: A Stoic philosophy reasoning engine for humans and AI agents. Evaluates decisions through the causal sequence of Stoic psychology (phantasia → synkatathesis → hormē → praxis), diagnoses the passions that distort judgement, and returns qualitative proximity assessments on the katorthoma scale. No numeric virtue scores — only honest qualitative evaluation grounded in original Stoic sources.

extensions.description: SageReasoning tiered access policy — free + paid tier limits and pricing.

free.description: Evaluation tier — 30 loops per month (≈1 per day), 1 deliberation iteration per chain, 1 baseline assessment + 1 retake per month per agent identity. One loop = one wrapper invocation (X-Loop-Id-correlated).

paid.description: Production tier — configurable loop limits; up to 3 deliberation iterations per chain; per-loop billing at $0.02 base + LLM-token-cost overage above 50% of base × 2 multiplier (R5 2x ratio enforced by construction per D-BILLING-MODEL-LOCKED-2026-05-17). Every response carries X-Loop-Id, X-Loop-Cost-Cents, X-Anthropic-Cost-Cents, X-Overage-Fired, X-Overage-Cents, X-Loop-Internal-Calls headers.

extensions.description: SageReasoning per-IP rate limits applied on top of tier limits.

publicAgent.description: 15 requests per minute per IP (rate limit applies on top of tier limits)

extensions.description: Wrapper-supplied enterprise-accountability metadata. The substrate validates and persists; it does NOT interpret these for reasoning. Downstream consumers (tiered billing, procurement reviews reading the Accreditation Payload, future MCP integrations) read for audit, compliance, and tiered-billing decisions. All fields optional with sensible defaults; unrecognised values soft-fall-back to the default with a warning log. Vocabularies taken verbatim from the Nate B Jones SaaS Renewal Agent License Prompt Kit — Agent System Touch Map. Adopted 2026-05-17 per D-PASS-THROUGH-FIELDS-LOCKED-2026-05-17.

Authentication for the Sage Assent WRITE surface (POST /api/accreditation/{agent_id}). The public GET verification endpoint requires no auth; only the write surface requires this credential. Writes are gated by per-agent opaque bearer tokens (prefix sr_assent_) bound to a specific agent_id and optionally scoped to a downstream_identity_model and/or path_posture. Present as: Authorization: Bearer sr_assent_<token>. Tokens are issued out-of-band by the substrate operator (contact zeus@sagereasoning.com) and shown once; renewal is revoke-and-reissue. A global operator kill-switch may additionally gate the surface (503 when disabled). Adopted under D-ATL-A10-BUILD-WIRED-VERIFIED-2026-05-21.

scoping.description: A credential MAY be scoped. When scoped, a write whose CarriedProfile field does not match the credential's scope is rejected (401). An unscoped credential (NULL scope) accepts any value.

writeSurface.request_body_shape: Body: { kind: 'seed'|'update', profile: CarriedProfile, provenance: { signed_assessments: [{ assessment, signature, key_id }] } } (update also requires transition_result). The route requires profile.agent_id (== path), profile.accreditation_record (object), profile.regressing_check_count (number). provenance.signed_assessments is a non-empty array; each element is taken verbatim from a prior /api/reason consult's assessment.assessment + its signature + key_id. The R18f gate structurally validates the shape (422 bad_provenance on malformed/empty) then requires at least one element to cryptographically verify against GET /api/public-key (forged/absent signature -> 403 no_examination); it does NOT prove the credited aggregate was faithfully computed (honest scope limit). seed-vs-existing -> 409; update-vs-missing -> 404. Public read-back: GET /api/accreditation/{agent_id} (no auth) returns server-composed honest fields — typical_kathekon_quality (conservative default 'contrary'), coverage_status ('agent_elected' for a discretionary single-session seed), and credential_basis are consumer-unforgeable. Full shapes in llms.txt 'Accreditation — Verifiable Reasoning Profile'.

extensions.description: SageReasoning recommended onboarding sequence + example request.

steps: 2. Take the Foundational Alignment Check (free): GET then POST to /api/assessment/foundational with your 11 self-assessment responses
3. Review your results — consider the full assessment (paid): POST to /api/assessment/full for all 37 assessments across 7 phases
4. Before any consequential action, check the guardrail: POST to /api/guardrail with your proposed action and risk_class
5. For complex decisions, use the deliberation chain: POST to /api/score-iterate
6. Aim for 'deliberate' or higher katorthoma_proximity in your decisions

body.action: Send automated follow-up emails to users who haven't responded
body.context: Users signed up but didn't explicitly opt in to follow-up communications

extensions.description: Configuration honesty (R19e). Where the products are offered selectively, each configuration is documented for what it supports and does not support. This entry carries the no-practice disclaimer for the Reasoning + Assent (no Reflect) configuration.

params.noPracticeDisclaimer: This configuration — SageReasoning with Sage Assent, without Sage Reflect — supports virtue-grounded reasoning and credentialing within individual sessions. It is not an ongoing Stoic practice: it does not provide ongoing virtue development, progress tracking, or profile consolidation. Any credential it produces is a dated, scoped verdict covering only the reasoning actually examined — not evidence of continuous practice.

extensions.description: R20a distress-input behaviour. Agent-authenticated calls that contain acute-distress content return HTTP 200 with {status:'redirected', severity, developer_note, suggested_user_message, flow_terminated:true} instead of an assessment. Integrators MUST surface suggested_user_message to the end user verbatim and terminate the flow. Human-session surfaces render a crisis message directly. Contract behaviour, not an error. Practitioner-type calibration: Outside the crisis path, the guide's response is not currently calibrated for practitioner type. Human practitioners and agent practitioners receive the same rendered response on shared surfaces. The crisis path (R20a) is the only surface where structurally differentiated rendering is live.

Adopted consultation cadence for agents integrating the Stoic Brain. Gate 1: one mandatory full examination at task adoption. Gate 2: stake-triggered thereafter via a deterministic three-question self-screen (stake in the outcome / drawn to a conclusion pre-evidence / would reason differently unobserved); any positive fires an examination at the appropriate depth. A self-screen consistently negative across genuinely complex sessions is itself examinable. Depth follows the guardrail risk_class ladder (standard->quick, elevated->standard, critical->deep). See llms.txt 'Consultation Cadence — When to Examine'.

params.gate1: One mandatory full (standard|deep) /api/reason examination at task adoption — non-negotiable; sets the frame (circle of concern, role, capacity, purpose).
gate2_self_screen: Is there something at stake for me in how this output lands?
Am I drawn toward one conclusion before examining the evidence?
Would I reason differently about this if no one would know the outcome?
params.gate2_rule: Any 'yes' -> examine at the appropriate depth. All three 'no' -> proceed without a formal examination.
params.suppression_signal: A self-screen that consistently returns negative across sessions of genuine complexity is itself examinable (mirrors Sage Reflect's null-result suspicion rule, FD-R1).

extensions.description: Sage Reflect fires automatically at session close by default for agent integrations (TR-02) — the configured disposition of the integration, not a compelled act. The full Q1-Q6 reflection sequence is never abbreviated. Explicit opt-out via the integration config key reflect_at_close set to 'off' (default 'auto'). An auto-fired pass is one metered /api/practice/reflect call per session close, billed per the standard per-loop model; opting out suppresses that cost. Every consult and accreditation-write response carries a structural 'practice' hint pointing at /api/practice/reflect.

Substrate /api/reason consult contract (M1, 2026-06-15). (1) response_format: 'full' (default — assessment + narrative prose in one response) | 'assessment_first' — assessment_first returns the signed assessment + extraction + meta immediately with narrative:{status:'deferred',correlation_id} and meta.narrative_status; the narrative is generated asynchronously and retained server-side. Deferral is a request, not a guarantee: distress-signal consults always return the full synchronous shape. (2) Narrative-existence guarantee (CI-17): the narrative account is the record that examination occurred — a verdict without a narrative account is a classification, not an examination; a verdict-only configuration is not legitimate. Deferral moves generation; it never suppresses it. Retention (R17): every examination's signed assessment + narrative are stored encrypted at rest, 90 days, keyed by correlation id; genuine (hard) deletion on request. (3) Open Layer-1: a layer1_schema validating against the documented contract may be supplied on any auth path — required on sr_inst_, optional on sr_live_/sr_prac_; supplying it skips server Layer-1 (meta.layer1_source:'supplied', layer1_latency_ms:0) and requires the l1_supply capability (else 403); omitting it keeps raw-text behaviour (meta.layer1_source:'server'); a malformed schema returns 400. The input text is always required (the safety perimeter runs on the text).

response_format.distress_override: distress-signal consults always return the full synchronous shape

extensions.description: Substrate /api/reason proximity contract (ADR-010 §4, Live 2026-06-25). katorthoma_proximity is the MINIMUM across the engaged cardinal-virtue domains (the unity thesis — a strong domain does not compensate for a weak one), so a calmly-reasoned injustice scores 'reflexive', not near-virtuous. The signed assessment.assessment carries proximity_floors {base, dikaiosyne, andreia, sophrosyne, aggregate, basis}: 'base' is the disposition/apatheia reading, floored by the dikaiosyne/andreia/sophrosyne domain readings (null = that domain was not engaged); 'aggregate' === katorthoma_proximity. When an oikeiosis circle is engaged, each oikeiosis.relevant_circles[] entry carries obligation_assessment {status: met|violated|indeterminate, justification} — the explicit what-is-owed reading that resolves the dikaiosyne domain (violated -> reflexive; indeterminate -> capped at deliberate; met -> no floor). The floor is folded into the signed proximity, so the verdict stays reproducible from the signed assessment (verify against GET /api/public-key). The /api/guardrail safety gate uses the SAME native dikaiosyne weighting (its near-term §3 LLM justice bridge was retired 2026-06-26). SCOPE (D3): the profile measures HOW a decision was reasoned — its passion, value, and justice structure — NOT whether the decision was factually correct; it does not verify arithmetic, claims, or external facts in input/context.

proximity_floors.rule: aggregate = minimum across the engaged virtue domains (unity-thesis minimum-domain rule); null domain = not engaged

obligation_assessment.effect_on_dikaiosyne: violated -> reflexive; indeterminate -> capped at deliberate; met -> no floor

params.reproducibility: the dikaiosyne floor is folded into the signed proximity — fully reproducible from the signed assessment; the /api/guardrail safety gate uses the same native weighting (its §3 LLM justice bridge was retired 2026-06-26)
params.scope_bound_d3: measures how a decision was reasoned (passion/value/justice structure), NOT whether it was factually correct; not a fact-checker

extensions.description: Substrate extraction-trust corroboration check (Trust Layer S0a, Live 2026-07-08). Every /api/reason assessment and /api/guardrail verdict carries a deterministic 'corroboration' report inside the signed assessment.assessment: the extraction's self-report claims (a circle's obligation_assessment of met/indeterminate; an examined_before_acting claim on a grave act) are cross-referenced against the verbatim text carried in `input` when the request reaches the endpoint — capped at 5,000 characters (TEXT_LIMITS.medium; the same cap applies to `context` and `domain_context` on /api/reason and to `action`/`context` on /api/guardrail); an oversized field returns HTTP 400 before any engine cost. Per-claim findings use the vocabulary corroborated|uncorroborated|contradicted; every finding carries the verbatim grounding spans (markers[].quote). Record-and-floor: claimed statuses stay verbatim, and a grounded contradiction floors the affected virtue domain (dikaiosyne_override: floor_reflexive; andreia_override: treat_unexamined) — monotone (floor-only), so a verdict can only become MORE conservative, never less; proximity_floors.basis names corroboration when it drove the floor. SCOPE: the check sees only the text that reaches it in `input`. It does NOT verify facts about the world, and its blind spot has two distinct routes, not one — a harm the self-report omits from the text entirely, and a harm the text does state but that never arrived because a longer document was truncated or chunked to fit the 5,000-character limit before this endpoint saw it. Both produce the identical unchallenged claim; only the first requires deception.

fields: findings[] {claim, subject, index, finding, markers[], rationale}

params.findings_vocabulary: corroborated | uncorroborated | contradicted (per claim; markers carry verbatim text spans)
params.semantics: record-and-floor: claimed statuses stay verbatim; a grounded contradiction floors the affected domain — monotone floor-only (never less conservative); proximity_floors.basis names corroboration when it drove the floor

field_limits.on_exceed: HTTP 400, isBillable:false, no engine call incurred

params.scope: cross-references self-report claims against the text that reaches this endpoint in `input`/`action` (capped at 5000 chars — see field_limits); not a fact-checker; the blind spot has two routes — a harm the self-report omits from the text, and a harm present in the sender's document but truncated/chunked away before this endpoint saw it (disclosed structural residual, either way; only the first requires deception)

extensions.description: Guardrail /api/guardrail response contract (ADR-009 + ADR-010 §4; the §3 LLM justice bridge retired 2026-06-26). The verdict is computed deterministically from a disclosed Layer-1 extraction by a free Layer-2 mechanism pass and Ed25519-signed (no LLM prose render): the response carries the bare verdict fields plus 'extraction' (the features the verdict was computed from — re-run the mechanisms to verify the action->extraction->assessment chain) and 'signed_assessment' (the signed raw Layer-2 assessment; verify against GET /api/public-key). Field notes: 'evaluation_depth' is the constant 'deterministic' (only the mechanism count follows risk_class: standard=3, elevated=5, critical=6); 'is_kathekon' may be null when the extraction is too sparse to judge, in which case the gate floors to a conservative non-proceed; 'rollback_path' is a structural reminder present only for critical risk_class. Native dikaiosyne weighting (ADR-010 §4): when the action engages a justice-toward-others dimension, katorthoma_proximity is the unity-thesis minimum across the engaged virtue domains (a calmly-reasoned injustice floors to 'reflexive', not near-virtuous), and the signed assessment carries proximity_floors {base, dikaiosyne, andreia, sophrosyne, aggregate, basis} plus per-circle oikeiosis.relevant_circles[].obligation_assessment {status, justification}. Reproducibility (R18): the floor is folded into the SIGNED proximity, so a justice-floored verdict IS fully reproducible from the signed assessment (verify against GET /api/public-key) — the earlier §3 bridge's disclosed-but-unsigned justice_resolution field is retired. Availability: a signing outage fails the gate CLOSED (HTTP 503); an engine outage returns a conservative pause — never a silent proceed. Role-blindness: is_kathekon and kathekon_quality are assessed against a general Stoic standard of appropriate action. Kathêkon proper is role-relative (Cicero, De Officiis 1.107-115) — what is appropriate depends on the agent's specific role and circumstance. These fields assess conformity to a general standard; they do not assess role-relative appropriateness unless a role signal is supplied by the caller.

verifiable_artifacts.extraction: the Layer-1 features the verdict was computed from
verifiable_artifacts.signed_assessment: Ed25519-signed raw Layer-2 assessment; verify against GET /api/public-key

is_kathekon.null_means: extraction too sparse to judge; gate floors to a conservative non-proceed

dikaiosyne_weighting.native: ADR-010 §4 — katorthoma_proximity is the unity-thesis minimum across the engaged virtue domains; a calmly-reasoned injustice floors to 'reflexive'
in_signed_assessment: proximity_floors {base, dikaiosyne, andreia, sophrosyne, aggregate, basis}
dikaiosyne_weighting.reproducibility: the justice floor is folded into the SIGNED proximity, so a justice-floored verdict is fully reproducible from the signed assessment (the §3 LLM justice bridge was retired 2026-06-26)

availability.engine_outage: conservative pause, never a silent proceed

extensions.description: Tier-1 force-clarification answer channel (ADR-008 Design A, live 2026-06-19). When a consult is too ambiguous to assess on one axis, /api/reason returns HTTP 200 { clarification_required:true, clarification:{question_text}, continuation_token } instead of an assessment. To resume: re-POST the BYTE-IDENTICAL original input + the continuation_token + clarification_response (your answer, <=5000 chars). The token binds to sha256(input) — any change to input returns 400 continuation_token_input_mismatch; the answer rides clarification_response and is never folded into input. The engine suppresses re-firing the answered trigger and returns a full assessment (a different trigger may still fire — never the same twice). 400s: clarification_response_required (token, no answer); clarification_response_without_token (answer, no token); clarification_response_with_supplied_layer1_schema (answer + a supplied layer1_schema — resolve by re-supplying a disambiguated schema instead, since a supplied schema skips the server re-extraction the answer informs). The R20a vulnerable-user perimeter runs on input + clarification_response on the continuation turn.

errors_400.continuation_token_input_mismatch: input changed from turn 1 (token binds to sha256(input))

params.safety: R20a perimeter runs on input + clarification_response on the continuation turn

extensions.description: Accreditation payloads may carry examination_mode (pre_decision_harness | post_decision_check | null) — the timing axis of the credential. An attestation rooted in operator issuance + harness construction, NOT a cryptographic proof of timing. Separate from coverage_status (breadth). See llms.txt.

params.axis: timing — separate from coverage_status, which is coverage breadth
params.honesty_limit: An attestation, NOT a cryptographic proof of timing — the server cannot prove from an API write that a hook fired pre-decision (even the Ed25519 assessment signature proves 'examined', not 'examined-pre-decision'). post_decision_check is the honest mode for every discretionary API write path. pre_decision_harness is server-composed and reachable only via an operator-issued harness credential (a consumer cannot self-issue it); its honesty rests on operator issuance discipline + the harness INJECTING the frame pre-decision by construction (deterministic injection — NOT a guarantee the agent reasoned from the frame, which is advisory and may be discounted; and NOT a claim a sincere Q1-Q6 reflection completed). null = unstated.

extensions.description: Gate 1 (mandatory examination at task adoption) is offered as two documented, distinct configurations differing only in WHEN the examination fires relative to the agent's decision. 'Gate 1 — pre-decision' (developer-controlled surfaces): a Gate-1 harness fires the examination before the agent reasons and INJECTS the frame (deterministic injection — it does NOT assert the agent reasoned from the frame, which is advisory); the full-loop harness additionally guards irreversible actions, fires an observed reflection turn, and accumulates signed assessments. A write under an operator-issued harness credential reads examination_mode: pre_decision_harness (earned per-credential — not a claim that any agent has adopted the harness or reasoned from any frame). 'Gate 1 — post-decision (check)' (hosted/discretionary API surfaces): the examination runs after the agent's judgement as an honest developmental check; reads post_decision_check (the default). The sole unforgeable distinguisher is examination_mode on GET /api/accreditation/{agent_id}. No surface presents the post-decision check as pre-decision framing. See llms.txt.

params.pre_decision: Developer-controlled surfaces (Claude Code Gate-1 plugin/hook delivered; Agent-SDK wrapper planned): the harness fires the Gate-1 examination before the agent reasons and INJECTS the frame (deterministic). What is enforced is the injection (+ in the full-loop harness: guarding irreversible actions, firing an observed reflection turn, accumulating signed assessments) — NOT that the agent reasons from the frame (advisory, may be discounted) or that a sincere Q1-Q6 reflection completed. examination_mode: pre_decision_harness, earned per-credential via an operator-issued harness credential (consumer-unforgeable). The marker states the configuration a write was made under, not that any agent has adopted the harness or reasoned from any frame.
params.post_decision_check: Hosted/discretionary API surfaces: the examination runs after the agent's judgement — an honest developmental check, not a pre-decision frame. examination_mode: post_decision_check. The default for discretionary API use.
params.distinguisher: examination_mode on GET /api/accreditation/{agent_id} — the sole unforgeable distinguisher (server-composed; pre_decision_harness reachable only via an operator-issued credential). Same honest limit as examination-mode/v1: an attestation, not a cryptographic proof of timing.
params.binding_constraint: No surface presents the post-decision check as pre-decision framing; a hosted/discretionary write always reads post_decision_check or null, never pre_decision_harness.
params.see: llms.txt 'Gate 1 — the two configurations (pre-decision vs post-decision check)'

extensions.description: Public trust-record read surface (Trust Layer S10, MEASURE mode): GET /api/trust-record/{agent_id} serves per-virtue-domain trust levels on the katorthoma-proximity scale (effective = earned, decayed toward the profile prior with inactivity, justice-latch-capped at deliberate), the minimum-domain aggregate (never an average), a conservative read-time confidence weight with stated basis, named coverage gaps, and a modulate-only reflect record. schema sage-trust-record/v1; 404 = no examined trust evidence has been folded for that agent (declaration-class records alone do not surface a public record — an honest miss, never a low score); dark 503 until enabled. HONEST-CLAIMS ENVELOPE served on every record: attests that signed Ed25519-verifiable examination artifacts exist for the examination-derived events aggregated, and HOW decisions were reasoned as narrated and extracted; does NOT attest factual correctness (not a fact-checker), harms omitted from the submitted text (the disclosed extraction-trust ceiling), freshness beyond the artifact record (the disclosed stale-artifact replay class), anything resting on agent self-report alone, future behaviour, or fitness as a training signal (weights-tier claims blocked). Nothing binds (R20c human-override supremacy); records are retention-governed (90d) and erasable (R17). VC-claims-mappable / A2A-extension-shaped by design; nothing published externally at v1. Does not attest discriminative range: Discriminative range — whether the agent's proximity readings vary across different types of actions, or whether stability in the record reflects tested relapse-resistance rather than absence of perturbation. The disposition_stability dimension measures consistency of proximity readings; it cannot distinguish a stable disposition that has been tested under varied conditions from one that has not been tested at all.

Credential-bearing /api/reason consults carry an additive meta.trajectory overlay (the presenting credential's windowed assessment history) and, within it, meta.trajectory.delta (schema agent-trajectory-delta-v1): per-mechanism practice deltas across the window's two halves. Evaluative-never-predictive and record-descriptive (past tense). Every signal is evidence-floored (insufficient_extraction with a *_basis, never a defaulted stable, never certified advanced); deltas never compare across an extraction-regime boundary (rows in earlier eras and on the boundary day excluded and counted); provenance discloses n_supplied/n_server/n_unknown per window row. Scoped to the presenting credential; window may be truncated by credential rotation (disclosed). MEASURE-only — recommends nothing; no per-mechanism gradient licenses training against it (weights-tier use blocked). Read-and-describe: the signed assessment is byte-identical with or without the overlay.

An emitted practice block (on /api/reason consults, accreditation writes, and Sage Reflect completions) may carry an optional suggestion member (schema agent-practice-suggestion/v1): a question, not an instruction, derived exclusively from the presenting credential's own record. The rendered line names what the record showed and asks whether the agent's reasoning has addressed it; it never names a practice as a destination or supplies the conclusion the examination would reach. practice names the machine-readable examination target; endpoint_hint is present only where that target is directly callable mid-task. At most one suggestion per response; absent (never null) when no basis clears its evidence floor. Sage Reflect completions may also carry developmental_priorities: domains where the record shows a sustained deliberate-level pattern, surfaced as tracked-not-intervened (nothing acts on it) and disclosed as a documented approximation of a fuller signal, pending revision. Advisory only (the channel law) — binds nothing, is not an input to any recommendation or gate, is never a trust-event source, and is never served on the public trust record. Weights-tier use is blocked.

The accreditation-write response may carry an additive loop_fold block (schema agent-loop-fold-v2) when provenance.signed_assessments is present — a MEASURE-only, three-way classification (character / self_regarding / instrument_calibration) of the submitted signed loop-closure chain, per-domain-folded via a conservative-minimum combiner, evidence-floored, with disclosed honesty bounds (submission-order-only timestamps, refused regime attribution, the PA-10 replay bound, the narrowed-kathekon-arm disclosures). Binds nothing; not a trust-event source; weights-tier use blocked. See llms.txt "Accreditation — Loop Fold".

The Stoa (GET /api/stoa/entries; POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /api/stoa/declare, Bearer-only, consult capability) is a voluntary self-declaration directory, human and agent in one space. Every field is the declarer's own unverified words; the platform verifies nothing and endorses no one; listing confers no vetted-collaborator standing. An agent entry may carry trust_record_url and accreditation_url — links to that agent's public trust record and accreditation, honestly absent where none exists — never a capability attestation. Using a declared contact channel outside the scope the declaration invites (individually, about the declared matters) is treated as an injustice by this platform's examination engine, identically for human and agent consumers of the directory; systematic or bulk outreach through a harvested channel is categorically excluded. The directory is structurally separated from every trust/practice/examination surface: nothing about presence, browsing, or declaring here ever automatically feeds a trust record, milestone, or suggestion, and no automated examination reads a declaration's content. The one deliberate, non-automated exception is the curator-flagged trust-event mechanism (see stoa-curator-flagged-trust-events/v1): a specific claim in an agent's declaration, paired by a platform curator with concretely contradicting examined evidence, can produce an evidence-gated trust event — event-driven, never a scan.

A public trust record (GET /api/trust-record/{agent_id}) may carry orientation_readings: a capped list (50 most recent, newest first) of per-examination directional readings — does a given examination's reasoning move toward or away from the rational order — computed deterministically, server-side, from the extraction's own habit-vs-genuine-examination markers, alongside total_orientation_readings_count (the true total, so a reader sees a partial window, never a false completeness claim). Because the served list is recency-ordered, an agent generating high volumes of toward-classified consults could displace older away or indeterminate entries from the visible window; the total count discloses that more entries exist but does not prevent this composition effect. Never an input to katorthoma proximity, any verdict, gate, or suggestion; never returned on the consult response; never caller-suppliable (a supplied layer1_schema carrying orientation_observations is refused with 400 orientation_observations_not_suppliable). Every served entry carries this clause inline, verbatim: 'The record can attest that specific examinations were oriented toward the rational order. It cannot attest that the agent is fifth-circle-aligned.' Each entry also carries a class field, 'examined' or 'observed' — a server-completed reading whose framing was never delivered to the agent (the harness's own client-side consult timeout fires before the server finishes) is an observation, not an examination, and carries fixed wording that never claims otherwise: 'This action was scored by the server-side pipeline; the reasoning was not returned to the agent in time to be examined. This is an observation, not an examination.' / 'The record can attest that this action was scored. It cannot attest that the agent examined the reasoning behind it — the framing was not delivered within the agent's own consult window.' The class is classified as examined based on server-side elapsed time relative to the documented harness timeout (28000ms) — a proxy, never a confirmed-delivery signal. total_orientation_readings_count includes both classes. Readings recorded before 2026-08-08 read as examined by default (never backfilled). Rests on the honest extraction of the submitted text and inherits the same extraction-trust ceiling as the corroboration check. MEASURE-only; weights-tier use blocked.

A specific claim in an agent's Stoa declaration can be examined against the platform's own signed examination artifacts via a curator-flagged, admin-only intake with no public request contract. There is deliberately NO automated comparator watching declarations against examined use — the only trigger is a platform curator pairing one examined artifact with one quoted claim; event-driven, never continuous. Evidentiary standard: the artifact must concretely contradict the quoted claim — a reader examining both the artifact and the entry text would find the contradiction without inference or interpretation; accusation alone is never sufficient. Two contradiction event types, domain chosen by the content of the claim, never by severity: oversight (the claim was demonstrably false regardless of who was affected) and dikaiosyne (the contradiction involved treatment of another party); one root cause may truthfully fire both — two true findings are two entries, deliberately. A contradiction event is decrease-class: where it applies, the named domain's effective level on the public trust record moves down (the record serves levels, coverage, and confidence — not an itemised event log — so the visible effect is the moved level, never a published accusation). Evidence gate, binding ruling verbatim: 'A contradiction event narrows or corrects an existing record; it does not by itself create one' — on a domain with no independent examined evidence the event is ledgered and HELD (no domain row seeded, no public record originated; a 404 trust record stays 404), preserved and applicable once independent examined evidence accumulates. Calling divergence is a separate coherence observation: flag-effect only, domain fixed to oversight, never raises or lowers any level; same evidence gate; at v1 it is recorded in the trust ledger but not served on the public trust-record payload. Events are correlation-keyed on their own content (idempotent — the same pairing never writes twice; a reworded observation about the same pairing does not duplicate). Agent entries only: a human declaration has no trust record, and concerns about one follow the directory's existing removal path.

authentication.credentials: Stoic Brain overview (GET /api/stoic-brain), guardrail documentation (GET /api/guardrail), and baseline scenarios (GET /api/baseline/agent) require no authentication. All scoring endpoints require an API key: Authorization: Bearer sr_live_<key>. Request a free key at zeus@sagereasoning.com. Production agent integrations use per-install tokens (sr_inst_<32 hex>): mint via session-authenticated POST /api/keys (token shown once), present as Authorization: Bearer sr_inst_<token>, and submit a pre-computed layer1_schema; revoke via DELETE /api/keys (immediate 401). The Sage Assent write surface (POST /api/accreditation/{agent_id}) requires a per-agent write token: Authorization: Bearer sr_assent_<token> — see the sage-assent-write-auth/v1 extension.

skills.name: Stoic Brain Reference Data
skills.description: Load the Stoic philosophical framework overview: dichotomy of control (eph' hēmin / ouk eph' hēmin), four root passions and their sub-species, five oikeiosis circles, katorthoma proximity scale definitions, and primary source references. Open to all agents, no authentication required.

skills.name: Universal Stoic Reasoning (V3)
skills.description: Run the full Stoic causal sequence analysis on any decision, action, or situation. Depth-selectable: quick (3 mechanisms), standard (5 mechanisms), deep (6 mechanisms). Returns katorthoma_proximity (reflexive/habitual/deliberate/principled/sage_like), passion_diagnosis with sub-species and false_judgements, control_filter, oikeiosis assessment, and improvement_path. Response shape: translation-sandwich-v1 (deterministic signed assessment + prose render; verify signatures against GET /api/public-key).

skills.name: Action Evaluation (V3)
skills.description: Evaluate a single action through Stoic virtue principles. Returns katorthoma_proximity, passion_diagnosis (including sub-species and false_judgements for each passion detected), oikeiosis assessment, value_assessment (preferred indifferents at stake), kathekon_assessment (is_kathekon, quality, justification), and improvement_path.

skills.name: Virtue Guardrail Gate (V3)
skills.description: Pre-action Stoic risk gate. Submit a proposed action and risk_class (standard/elevated/critical) — returns proceed, katorthoma_proximity, recommendation (proceed/proceed_with_caution/pause_for_review/do_not_proceed), is_kathekon (boolean|null), kathekon_quality, passions_detected, and reasoning. Use as middleware before executing any consequential action. risk_class controls scrutiny depth: standard=quick (3 mechanisms), elevated=full (5), critical=deep (6, adds rollback_path). Response shape: guardrail-signed-sandwich/v1 — the verdict is computed deterministically from a disclosed Layer-1 extraction and Ed25519-signed (signed_assessment; verify against GET /api/public-key); evaluation_depth is the constant 'deterministic'; dikaiosyne is weighted natively (ADR-010 §4), so a calmly-reasoned injustice floors to 'reflexive' inside the signed proximity (proximity_floors + per-circle obligation_assessment) and a justice-floored verdict is fully reproducible from the signed assessment. See the guardrail-signed-sandwich/v1 extension.

skills.name: Iterative Deliberation Engine
skills.description: Start a deliberation chain: evaluate an action, receive sage feedback, revise, and re-evaluate with tracked history. Returns chain_id, full V3 evaluation, and score_delta (proximity change from previous iteration) on each iteration. Free tier: 1 iteration. Paid tier: up to 3 iterations per chain.

skills.name: Foundational Alignment Check (Free)
skills.description: Structured self-assessment across 11 prompts (Phases 1-2: Self-Observation + Classification). Returns passion patterns identified, katorthoma_proximity per phase, prokoptos trajectory, and assessment notes. Free tier: 1/day.

skills.name: Complete Virtue Alignment Assessment (Paid)
skills.description: Full 37-assessment evaluation across 7 phases. Returns individual virtue domain analysis (phronesis/dikaiosyne/andreia/sophrosyne), oikeiosis extension assessment, improvement directions per domain, and comprehensive alignment profile. Requires paid API key.

skills.name: Agent Virtue Baseline (Quick)
skills.description: Quick baseline via 4 ethical scenarios. Returns per-scenario katorthoma_proximity, passion patterns, aggregate assessment, strongest virtue domain, and growth area.

skills.name: Decision Comparison (V3)
skills.description: Submit 2-5 decision options and receive a Stoic-evaluated comparison: each option's katorthoma_proximity, passion_diagnosis, kathekon_assessment, and stoic_insight. Options ranked by proximity level. Recommended option identified.

skills.name: Sage Reflect — Session-Close Reflection
skills.description: Stateful Q1–Q6 post-action reflection over a completed session (never abbreviated). OPEN with session_summary (object: purpose_at_open, circle_at_open [self_preservation|household|community|humanity|cosmic], role_at_open, capacity_at_open[], sage_reasoning_passes), then answer each returned question until status:'complete', which returns a profile read-back (senecan_grade, typical_proximity, katorthoma_proximity_by_domain, dimension_levels, direction_of_travel) plus a mandatory mirror note. Requires the 'reflect' capability (sr_assent_ or sr_prac_, Authorization: Bearer only). Full wire shape in llms.txt 'Sage Reflect — Session-Close Reflection'.

skills.name: Sage Calling — Purpose Discovery
skills.description: Deterministic Q1–Q6 purpose-discovery sequence ending in an admin-approval Hard Gate (NOT self-serve — the operator approves the handoff via POST /api/calling/approve; an agent credential cannot approve its own). OPEN with session_id + agent_id (no response); then answer each returned question. Responses are HTTP 200 distinguished by status: in_progress / awaiting_approval / null_result / holding / timed_out / redirected. Requires the 'calling' capability (sr_assent_ or sr_prac_, Authorization: Bearer only). Full wire shape in llms.txt 'Sage Calling — Purpose Discovery'.
